Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Aarav - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Hema - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Zoya - 12 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Vimla - 72 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Meera - 8 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Aarav stands in the bathroom. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Aarav, what's the plan today?"

[Aarav brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Aarav: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aarav takes a quick bath.]

Aarav: "What next?"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

Meera: "So, here we are!"

[Aarav yawns loudly.]

Meera: "And then?"

[Aarav stretches his arms above his head.]

Aarav: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Hema and Zoya stand near him.]

Aarav: "What a nice place."

[Aarav eats his breakfast at the table.]

Aarav: "Zoya, listen!"

[Aarav takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Zoya: "That's easy."

[Aarav munches on an apple.]

Aarav: "Careful!"

[Aarav drinks a glass of water.]

Aarav (happily): "I'm ready!"

[Aarav sips hot tea from a cup.]

Aarav: "This is amazing!"

[Aarav gulps down a glass of milk.]

Aarav: "Exactly right."

[Aarav serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Zoya: "Hmm, I see."

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Aarav stands in the courtyard. Hema and Vimla stand near him.]

Hema: "So, here we are!"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Aarav (gently): "I knew it!"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Aarav (happily): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
